transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. AI. What brings you in today?

For about the last 10 months, I've been feeling extremely unmotivated and emotionally flat. I just don't have the drive to do anything anymore, and I've completely withdrawn from my friends and family.
Have you been feeling depressed or down most days for at least two years, or did this start only within the last 10 months?
The severe lack of motivation and flatness started about 10 months ago. But looking back, I think some changes and smaller issues have been going on for about a year and eight months overall.
Did these symptoms begin after a specific stressful event or major life change, such as a breakup, job loss, or move?
No, I don't think there was any specific event or trigger like a breakup or job loss. It just seemed to start happening on its own, and I can't recall any major changes around that time.
Besides the low motivation and emotional flatness, have you had depressed mood or lost interest/pleasure in things most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yes, I've completely lost interest and pleasure in almost all the activities I used to enjoy for about 10 months now. It doesn't really feel like sadness or depression, but more like a total lack of interest and an inability to feel any joy.
Have you had these symptoms nearly every day for at least two years, even if they were less severe at times?

No, it hasn't been quite two years. Overall, I've noticed these changes for about a year and eight months, but the severe lack of interest and motivation has only been happening for the last 10 months.
